note: Compliance matrix. Every row cites an official Amazon or FTC source with a verbatim quote. No paraphrase is presented as a quote.

rows.requirement: An Associate must clearly and prominently state, on the site, a specific disclosure sentence (or a substantially similar statement previously allowed).
rows.quote: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
rows.section: Operating Agreement §5 (Identifying Yourself as an Associate)
rows.applied: Rendered in the site header disclosure bar and in the footer of every page.

rows.requirement: Amazon lists approved alternative disclosure wording.
rows.quote: Use approved language like “#paidlink,” “#ad,” or “CommissionsEarned,” or the statement “As an Amazon Associate, I earn from qualifying purchases.”
rows.applied: Site uses the full statement, not a hashtag-only form.

rows.requirement: Disclosure must sit next to the affiliate link and must not be hidden behind a click or a 'More' expansion.
rows.quote: Place your disclosure right next to your affiliate link where it’s easy to spot — not buried in hashtags, hidden below a “More” button, or tucked away. Keep the text clear and conspicuous.
rows.applied: Disclosure appears immediately above the product tables that contain the outbound links, not inside a collapsible element.

rows.requirement: FTC staff guidance on affiliate links: disclose the commission relationship clearly and conspicuously, close to the recommendation.
rows.quote: You should disclose your relationship to the retailer clearly and conspicuously on your site, so readers can decide how much weight to give your endorsement. You could say something like, “I get commissions for purchases made through links in this post.”
rows.section: What About Affiliate or Network Marketing?
rows.applied: Combined with C1 wording; placed adjacent to every link block.

rows.requirement: 'Affiliate link' alone, 'buy now', and 'commissionable link' are not adequate disclosures.
rows.quote: Consumers might not understand that “affiliate link” means that the person placing the link is getting paid for purchases made through the link. Similarly, a “buy now” button would not be adequate.
rows.section: What About Affiliate or Network Marketing?
rows.applied: Site never uses 'buy now' or 'affiliate link' as its only disclosure.

rows.requirement: A disclosure is not clear and conspicuous if the consumer must click or hover to see it.
rows.quote: In any communication using an interactive electronic medium, such as social media or the internet, the disclosure must be unavoidable. A disclosure is not clear and conspicuous if a consumer must take any action, such as clicking on a hyperlink or hovering over an icon, to see it.
rows.applied: Disclosure is static text on the page, not a modal, tooltip, or expandable panel.

rows.topic: Special Links — tracking tag is mandatory
rows.requirement: Each link must carry the Associate's own tracking ID. Untagged links do not accrue commission.
rows.quote: Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you.
rows.applied: FLAGGED: all three supplied links resolve without a tag= parameter. See irregularity I-2. The site reproduces the links exactly as supplied and prominently warns that they must be re-issued with a tracking ID.

rows.requirement: A site may show price/availability only if Amazon serves it, or if it comes through PA API / Creators API.
rows.quote: Because prices for and availability of Products that you have listed on your Site may change, your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API and you comply with the requirements regarding use of Creators API or PA API in the License.
rows.section: Participation Requirements §2(b) General Requirements Applicable to All Special Links
rows.applied: Site stores NO Amazon prices at all. It links out with 'check current price on Amazon' instead. This is why the price column reads 'not stored by design'.

rows.topic: No inaccurate or misleading product claims
rows.requirement: Must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive, or misleading claims about a product.
rows.quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.
rows.applied: Every spec on the site is quoted from the manufacturer's own product page, with the URL in the adjacent Source column. Unverified cells are blank.

rows.requirement: An endorser cannot claim experience with a product they have not used.
rows.quote: You can’t talk about your experience with a product you haven’t tried.
rows.applied: All generated articles are explicitly spec-based / desk research. Every article carries a 'no hands-on testing claimed' notice. No first-person use claims anywhere on the site.

rows.topic: Review site funded by affiliate links must disclose
rows.requirement: A review/comparison site that receives affiliate referral payments must clearly and conspicuously disclose that it receives such payments.
rows.quote: If, however, the review website does not take payments for higher rankings, but receives payments from some of the headphone manufacturers, such as for affiliate link referrals, it should clearly and conspicuously disclose that it receives such payments.
rows.applied: Rankings on this site are alphabetical/ASIN-order by supplied link order, not paid placement — and the affiliate disclosure is on every page. Also covered by §255.5(a) material-connection disclosure.

rows.requirement: Sites should carry the Amazon trademark attribution statement and must not put Amazon marks in domains or handles.
rows.quote: Include the following statement on your site(s) - “Amazon and the Amazon logo are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.”
rows.section: Top Dos and Don'ts — Amazon Trademarks
rows.applied: Attribution statement in the footer of every page. Domain is github.io/Zone1 — contains no Amazon mark.

rows.topic: Trademarks — no Amazon marks in domain/username/tag
rows.requirement: No Amazon trademark, variant, or misspelling in domain, subdomain, tag, or social username.
rows.quote: include any trademark of Amazon or its affiliates, or a variant or misspelling of a trademark of Amazon or its affiliates in any domain name, subdomain name, in any “tag” or Associates ID, or in any username, group name, or other identifier on any social networking site
rows.applied: Site host path is /Zone1; no Amazon mark used as an identifier.

rows.requirement: A commission-bearing session ends at 24 hours, or on order placement, or on another Special Link click; cart orders qualify up to 89 days after the initial click.
rows.quote: during a single session, which is measured as beginning when a customer clicks through that Special Link and ending upon the first to occur of the following: (x) 24 hours elapse from that click, (y) the customer places an order for a Product ... or (z) the customer clicks through a Special Link to an Amazon Site that is not your Special Link
rows.applied: Documented in the campaign playbook so link-placement decisions are made against the real attribution window.

rows.requirement: The product must ship/stream/download and be paid for within 180 days of purchase.
rows.quote: within 180 days of the purchase, the Product is shipped to, streamed or downloaded by, and paid for by the customer
rows.section: Commission Income Statement §1, item (c)(iii); changelog in S13
rows.applied: Documented in the campaign playbook.

rows.requirement: Cancelled/returned/refunded orders, purchases via the Associate's own paid search on Amazon marks, purchases via redirecting links, and untracked links are all disqualified.
rows.quote: the following purchases that would otherwise be Qualified Purchases are disqualified and excluded from the Associates Program: (a) any Product purchased after termination of your Agreement, (b) any Product order where a cancellation, return, or refund has been initiated, (c) any Product purchased by a customer who is referred to an Amazon Site through any advertisement that you purchased, including through participation in bidding or auctions on keywords, search terms, or other identifiers that include the word “amazon” ...
rows.applied: Playbook forbids bid-on-Amazon-trademark advertising and link cloaking that drops the click.

rows.requirement: Payment is made about 60 days after month end. Minimums: 10 USD direct deposit, 10 USD gift card, 100 USD check, with a 15 USD check processing fee.
rows.quote: We will pay Standard Commission Income and Special Commission Income in the default currency for an Amazon Site approximately 60 days following the end of each calendar month in which they were earned
rows.section: Commission Income Statement §6 and the Payment Minimum Chart
rows.applied: Documented on the compliance page with the chart values (10 / 10 / 100 / 15 USD).

rows.requirement: Amazon requires at least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days and reviews the site for original content.
rows.quote: After you sign up, our Associates team will check your application once you’ve driven qualified sales (we require at least three within the first 180 days). Please note that personal orders do not qualify.
rows.applied: Documented as a launch gate in the playbook.

rows.requirement: Creators API requires at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days; PA-API 5 is deprecated and returns 403.
rows.quote: Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API
rows.applied: This is why automated price/review ingestion is NOT live on this site: the account does not yet have the qualifying-sales history that the API requires. See I-13.

rows.requirement: Site must have original content; third-party material needs significant commentary, analysis, or transformation.
rows.quote: Your Site(s) must contain original content and be publicly available via the website address provided in the application. Original content utilizing third-party materials must contain significant commentary, analysis, or transformation to any materials you include.
rows.applied: Site ships original analysis pages, a scoring methodology, and three original articles. Product specs are attributed quotations, never copied wholesale.

rows.requirement: Compensation in exchange for Amazon customer reviews is prohibited by Amazon Community Guidelines.
rows.quote: It is against Amazon Community Guidelines to accept compensation, including cash, discounts, free products, gift cards, and refunds, in exchange for posting a customer review on product detail pages.
rows.section: Top Dos and Don'ts — Customer Reviews
rows.applied: Playbook prohibits review incentives. Site publishes no fabricated testimonials.

rows.requirement: As of the April 14, 2026 policy update, purchases referred through paid or boosted advertising linking to Amazon are excluded, with limited exceptions.
rows.quote: Expanded disqualified purchases to include products purchased by customers referred through any paid or boosted advertisement linking to Amazon, regardless of whether prohibited keywords are used. Limited exceptions apply.
rows.applied: Playbook restricts the paid-acquisition channel to non-Amazon destinations and forbids paid ads that link straight to Amazon.

rows.topic: Commission rate card — category rates ARE public; ASIN mapping is not
rows.requirement: Amazon publishes the fixed standard commission rate per product category. A publisher must state which category rate applies, and must not present a per-product or projected-earnings figure that Amazon does not publish.
rows.quote: Physical Books, Kitchen, Automotive | 4.50% ... All Other Categories | 4.00%
rows.section: Table 1 — Fixed Standard Commission Income Rates for Specific Product Categories
rows.applied: PUBLISHED WITH A CAVEAT. Kitchen is a listed category at 4.50% (S27, Table 1), and the catch-all is 4.00%. Air fryers sit in Kitchen, so 4.50% is shown as the category rate with a direct link to Table 1. Amazon does not publish an ASIN-to-category mapping, so the row is labelled 'category rate — per-ASIN mapping unconfirmed' and no revenue projection is made. An earlier version of this row wrongly said no rate was publicly readable; see I-14.
rows.correction: Supersedes this session's earlier I-14. Credit: session arena-105bc29e reached the table first and published it; this session independently re-fetched and confirmed it.

rows.topic: Program Content may not be altered
rows.requirement: Program Content must not be added to, deleted, or otherwise altered; only proportional resizing or non-material truncation of text is allowed.
rows.quote: You will not add to, delete from, or otherwise alter any Program Content in any way, including by adding additional information, except that you may resize Program Content consisting of a graphic image in a manner that maintains the original proportions of the image or truncate Program Content consisting of text in a manner that does not materially alter the meaning of the text or cause the text to become factually incorrect, or misleading.
rows.applied: Titles are reproduced verbatim on this site and never paraphrased. Where Amazon's own title is cited, it is labelled 'Verbatim Amazon listing title'. Whether a listing title counts as Program Content is not confirmed by Amazon, so this is flagged open at C24/F19.
rows.cross_reference: Raised independently by session arena-4ba9e055 as F19; neither the d14c5409 nor the original 8a2ddd06 matrix covered it.

rows.requirement: The site must disclose accurately the use of cookies, pixels and other technologies by the site and by third parties, and explain how data is collected, used, stored and disclosed.
rows.quote: disclosing on your Site accurately and adequately and otherwise satisfying applicable legal requirements, either through a privacy policy or otherwise, the use of cookies, pixels, and other technologies by you and third parties and how you collect, use, store, and disclose data collected from visitors in accordance with applicable laws
rows.applied: OPEN — this site sets no cookies and runs no analytics, and it carries no privacy policy page. That is a genuine gap, not an oversight to be hidden: the site links to Amazon, and Amazon's pages set cookies on the visitor's browser. Flagged as F20 and left open for the owner and legal review.
rows.cross_reference: Raised independently by session arena-4ba9e055 as F20; not covered by either earlier matrix.
